title: Mophead TBC Delivers His Highly anticipated Single Titled “Know My Name.”
htmlContent:
Emerging lyrical genius, Mophead TBC is a talented singer and songwriter from Brooklyn. The 16-year-old music star has an undying passion for writing and delivering his heartfelt words. All these traits are on full display in the release of his recent track “Know My Name.”

In his recent track “Know My Name,” Mophead TBC brings a refreshing  Hip Hop record that shows his incredible skills on another level. He embodies all of his musical styles ranging from his rhyme style to his excellent sound, showing us that he’s a true student of the game and master of his craft.
